'''Oramis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the [[Scions of Zakuul]] living during the [[war against Zakuul]]. After head Scion [[Heskal]] was killed by [[Arcann]] during the [[Battle of Asylum]], the remaining Scions fled wrath of his sister [[Vaylin]], who pursued them across known space. After Vaylin was killed by [[Alliance Commander|the Alliance Commander]], who claimed the [[Eternal Throne]] and proclaimed the [[Eternal Alliance]], the Scions traveled to the recently discovered worlds of [[Iokath]], where during the [[War on Iokath|battle for Iokath]] the Commander approached the Scions. Oramis explained why they were unable to assist in the revolt and that the recent events had awakened [[Tyth]], one of the [[Six Gods|Old Gods]] of Zakuul, who threatened to cause untold havoc once again. Oramis foretold that the Commander would confront the Gods and subdue them, being judged of being worthy to take possession of the droid shells.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Oramis appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' during the "Facing the Machines of War" mission on Iokath.
